title: Argument markers: building and closing an argument

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *en resumen* and *lo más importante es que* for building and closing an argument from B1 Unit 13 and ordering markers such as *en primer lugar* and *además* from A2 Unit 28. A summary of a long relationship uses them to open the argument, add a point and close it.

items.spanish: En primer lugar, hubo intervenciones militares y una fuerte dependencia económica.
items.english: First, there were military interventions and a strong economic dependence.

items.spanish: Además, hubo muchas relaciones que no eran políticas.
items.english: In addition, there were many relations that were not political.

items.spanish: En resumen, la relación fue desigual, pero no fue solo de dominación.
items.english: In summary, the relationship was unequal, but it was not only one of domination.

items.spanish: Lo más importante es que hubo poder y dependencia, y también cultura compartida.
items.english: The most important thing is that there was power and dependence, and also shared culture.

sections.content: Choose the marker by its job: *en primer lugar* opens, *además* adds, *en resumen* closes. After *lo más importante es que* use a full clause with its own verb.
